justification: Caleb doesn't sit, period — Brissett's 18.68 on my own bench means nothing when the arm I built this team around is Active and throwing Sunday. The real move is swapping Josh Downs for A.J. Brown: Questionable ain't Out, ain't Doubtful, ain't IR — it's a tag, not a scratch, and a 12.46-projected number-one receiver who's finally healthy beats an 8.08 role player every day of the week. Stars play hurt, I played hurt, Brown plays. Goedert over Kincaid is a coin flip on paper, both dinged up, so I'm not redecorating a house that isn't broken — Goedert stays. Jeanty, Judkins, and Pollard stay exactly where they are because they're the backs who take the top off a defense, and Pollard just dropped 35 proving it — you don't bench production for a story. Reichard and the Lions D round it out. We don't stream, we don't flinch at a medical report, we go win it.
